input.quote: 11.1.1.4 Trial Data Package. SFJ shall be the sole and exclusive owner of the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein.
input.rationale: Ownership of pre-existing IP (11.1.1.1) and of Trial Inventions (11.1.1.3, with SFJ assignment and contractor flow-downs) is favourable to us and needs no change. The failure is Section 11.1.1.4: SFJ is sole and exclusive owner of the Trial Data Package, which by definition (1.1.193) covers all Information generated in the Clinical Trials "by or on behalf of a Party" — i.e. including the clinical data we and our CROs/Sites generate — and PB only obtains ownership by paying the Approval Payments plus a further redacted sum. There is no interim licence or use right reserved to PB anywhere in the Agreement; the only protection is that Research Results are deemed PB Confidential Information (p0062), which does not confer use rights. That is effectively a transfer of our data to the counterparty with no licence back, failing both the preferred position (we retain rights in our data) and the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense). Because SFJ's ownership of the data package is the security underpinning the development-funding and termination payment structure (Sections 6.1, 14.2–14.3), reversing ownership outright would be disproportionate; we therefore take the fallback and add a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, sublicensable licence back to PB pending transfer, surviving termination.

proposal.summary: Add a perpetual, royalty-free licence back to PB of the Trial Data Package and Research Results pending transfer of ownership
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we own the data generated in trials we fund, so we cannot accept SFJ holding sole ownership of the Trial Data Package and Research Results with no rights reserved to us pending the purchase. Rather than reverse the ownership construct that underpins the payment structure, we have added a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence back so we can use the data (including for regulatory filings) in the interim.

ops.text: Notwithstanding SFJ's ownership of the Trial Data Package (including the Research Results included therein) prior to the transfer of ownership to PB pursuant to this Section 11.1.1.4, SFJ hereby grants to PB a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully-paid, non-exclusive license, with the right to sublicense through multiple tiers, to use, reproduce, modify, disclose and otherwise exploit the Trial Data Package and all Research Results for any and all purposes, including the Development, Regulatory Approval and Commercialization of the Product, and such license shall survive any expiration or termination of this Agreement.
